title: Local tensor comparison system with constant Q-coordinate
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, F a diagram of commutative rings with colimit A, and i₀ ≤ i. Let B₀,C₀ be commutative F(i₀)-algebras and φ₀:B₀ → C₀ an F(i₀)-algebra map. Write B_j=F(j)⊗_{F(i₀)}B₀ and C_j=F(j)⊗_{F(i₀)}C₀, and B=A⊗_{F(i₀)}B₀ and C=A⊗_{F(i₀)}C₀. Let P,Q be commutative rings and Q a P-algebra. Give B_i and B P-algebra structures such that the canonical map μB:B_i → B is P-linear. Let ψ:B_i⊗_P Q → C_i be a ring map restricting on B_i to id⊗φ₀. On J={j | i ≤ j} there exist P-structures on B_j, common-universe ring diagrams D,E, a natural transformation α, equivalences d_j:D(j) ≃ B_j⊗_P Q and c_j:E(j) ≃ C_j, cocones cD,cE with points equivalent via dLim,cLim to B⊗_P Q,C, and P-linear canonical maps μ_j:B_j → B. The source legs are μ_j⊗id_Q, source transitions are β_jk⊗id_Q with β_jk the P-linear canonical B_j → B_k, and target legs and transitions are canonical tensor maps under the equivalences. Every α transition square is a pushout. The conjugate c_j α_j d_j⁻¹ restricts to id⊗φ₀ on B_j. For each j,q, cLim cE.ι_j α_j d_j⁻¹(1⊗q)=μC_i ψ(1⊗q).

proof.text: Use the finite-stage comparison-diagrams theorem to obtain induced P-actions, diagrams, comparison transformation, stage equivalences, P-linear initial transitions βs_j, transition identities, pushout squares, left compatibility and the finite-stage Q formula. This statement uses no colimit data.
Construct the P-linear canonical maps μ_j to B from the initial transitions βs_j and μB; the canonical-maps theorem proves this by tensor-map composition and algebra-map compatibility.
Attach canonical source and target cocones by the canonical-cocones theorem, which is proved independently of ψ and α by explicit ULift constructions.

Assemble the witnesses and all existing clauses. For the final Q-coordinate clause evaluate the target cocone leg identity on α_j(d_j⁻¹(1⊗q)), apply the finite-stage Q formula, and compose canonical tensor maps using colimit.w. Tensor-map composition gives the canonical map at i.

proof_origin.place: Lean reduction to finite-stage diagrams and explicit canonical tensor cocones; final Q-coordinate derived by tensor-map composition. Second reading: direct Mathlib tensor-map composition and tensor induction are elementary identities, not applications of the tensor pushout universal-property node.

theorem exists_comparison_tensor_local_system
    {I : Type v} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{v}) [HasColimit F]
    (i₀ : I) (B₀ : Type w) (C₀ : Type x) [CommRing B₀] [CommRing C₀]
    [Algebra (F.obj i₀) B₀] [Algebra (F.obj i₀) C₀]
    (φ₀ : B₀ →ₐ[F.obj i₀] C₀)
    (P Q : Type y) [CommRing P] [CommRing Q] [Algebra P Q]
    (aP : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      Algebra P (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀))
    (i : I) (hi : i₀ ≤ i)
    (aPi : letI := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra
      Algebra P (↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀))
    (μB : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aPi
      letI := aP
      (↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) →ₐ[P] (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀))
    (hμB : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra
      let αi : F.obj i →ₐ[F.obj i₀] ↥(colimit F) :=
        { (colimit.ι F i).hom with
          commutes' := fun s ↦
            congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ colimit F ↦ f s) (colimit.w F (homOfLE hi)) }
      μB.toRingHom =
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αi (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) B₀)).toRingHom)
    (ψ : letI := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aPi
      ((↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) ⊗[P] Q) →+* (↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] C₀))
    (hψ : letI := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra
      letI := aPi
      ψ.comp (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom (R := P)
          (A := ↥(F.obj i) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) (B := Q)) =
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId (F.obj i) (F.obj i)) φ₀).toRingHom)
 :
      let J := {j : I // i ≤ j}
      ∃ (aPs : ∀ j : J,
          letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
          Algebra P (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀)),
        ∃ (D E : J ⥤ CommRingCat.{max v w x y}) (α : D ⟶ E),
          ∃ (d : ∀ j : J,
              letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
              letI := aPs j
              ↥(D.obj j) ≃+* (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) ⊗[P] Q),
            ∃ (c : ∀ j : J,
                letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                ↥(E.obj j) ≃+* (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] C₀)),
              ∃ (cD : Cocone D) (cE : Cocone E),
                ∃ (dLim : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := aP
                    ↥cD.pt ≃+* (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) ⊗[P] Q)
                  (cLim : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
                    ↥cE.pt ≃+* (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] C₀)),
                  ∃ (μs : ∀ j : J,
                    letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := aPs j
                    letI := aP
                    (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) →ₐ[P]
                      (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀)),
                  (∀ j : J,
                    letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    let αj : F.obj j.val →ₐ[F.obj i₀] ↥(colimit F) :=
                      { (colimit.ι F j.val).hom with
                        commutes' := fun s ↦
                          congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ colimit F ↦ f s)
                            (colimit.w F (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))) }
                    (μs j).toRingHom =
                      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αj (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) B₀)).toRingHom) ∧
                  (∀ j : J,
                    letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := aPs j
                    letI := aP
                    dLim.toRingHom.comp (cD.ι.app j).hom =
                      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (μs j) (AlgHom.id P Q)).toRingHom.comp
                        (d j).toRingHom) ∧
                  (∀ {j k : J} (r : j ⟶ k),
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans k.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := aPs j
                    letI := aPs k
                    ∃ β : (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) →ₐ[P]
                        (↥(F.obj k.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀),
                      (let αjk : F.obj j.val →ₐ[F.obj i₀] F.obj k.val :=
                        { (F.map (homOfLE (leOfHom r))).hom with
                          commutes' := fun s ↦
                            congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ F.obj k.val ↦ f s)
                              (F.map_comp (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))
                                (homOfLE (leOfHom r))).symm };
                        β.toRingHom =
                          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αjk
                            (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) B₀)).toRingHom) ∧
                      (d k).toRingHom.comp (D.map r).hom =
                        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map β (AlgHom.id P Q)).toRingHom.comp
                          (d j).toRingHom) ∧
                  (∀ j : J,
                    letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    let αj : F.obj j.val →ₐ[F.obj i₀] ↥(colimit F) :=
                      { (colimit.ι F j.val).hom with
                        commutes' := fun s ↦
                          congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ colimit F ↦ f s)
                            (colimit.w F (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))) }
                    cLim.toRingHom.comp (cE.ι.app j).hom =
                      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αj (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) C₀)).toRingHom.comp
                        (c j).toRingHom) ∧
                  (∀ {j k : J} (r : j ⟶ k),
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans k.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    let αjk : F.obj j.val →ₐ[F.obj i₀] F.obj k.val :=
                        { (F.map (homOfLE (leOfHom r))).hom with
                          commutes' := fun s ↦
                            congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ F.obj k.val ↦ f s)
                              (F.map_comp (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))
                                (homOfLE (leOfHom r))).symm }
                    (c k).toRingHom.comp (E.map r).hom =
                      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αjk (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) C₀)).toRingHom.comp
                        (c j).toRingHom) ∧
                  (∀ {j k} (r : j ⟶ k), IsPushout (α.app j) (D.map r)
                    (E.map r) (α.app k)) ∧
                (∀ j : J,
                  letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                  letI := aPs j
                  ((c j).toRingHom.comp ((α.app j).hom.comp (d j).symm.toRingHom)).comp
                    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom (R := P)
                      (A := ↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) (B := Q)) =
                    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId (F.obj j.val) (F.obj j.val))
                      φ₀).toRingHom)
 ∧
                  (∀ (j : J) (q : Q),
                    letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE hi)).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := aPi
                    letI := aPs j
                    let αi : F.obj i →ₐ[F.obj i₀] ↥(colimit F) :=
                      { (colimit.ι F i).hom with
                        commutes' := fun s ↦
                          congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ colimit F ↦ f s)
                            (colimit.w F (homOfLE hi)) }
                    cLim ((cE.ι.app j).hom ((α.app j).hom ((d j).symm (1 ⊗ₜ[P] q)))) =
                      Algebra.TensorProduct.map αi (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) C₀)
                        (ψ (1 ⊗ₜ[P] q)))
